description: We are three engineering students from Argentina who love space, maps and problem-solving. Our skills span software development, data engineering, geospatial analysis and machine learning. In one weekend we built RedWays, a tool that turns NASA Mars data into safe, science-driven Marswalk plans. We care about turning open data into clear decisions, and we enjoy learning fast as a team. If you like Mars, code or data, we'd love to collaborate!
